x.text:
Resist dunking*

I see it WAY too much with folks especially today. It’s the perfect dopamine loop - other people join in and you feel great. But, it just screams envy and doesn’t lead to anything productive. 

Sure, you can pat yourself on the back and say “see I told you so” but how did it move the world? Nowhere. If you think you can do it better, go do that then. Screaming about someone’s unfair advantages is not going to change your life - and probably leads to more sadness. 

Keep building. Continue to change the world. That’s the best way to have impact. Choose kindness above all else. 

* the only caveat here is if you’re calling out obvious fraud, or pointing out something that’s woefully bad, do it. there are very clearly some businesses that are going to be vaporware and if you have evidence call it out. that doesn’t scream envy, it’s factual and not dunking by any means.

x.textZh:
抵制嘲讽*

我看到太多人这样做了，尤其是在今天。这是一个完美的多巴胺循环——别人纷纷加入，你感觉爽极了。但这只会显得你满心嫉妒，而且带不来任何有建设性的结果。

当然，你可以沾沾自喜地说“看吧，我早就说过”，但这改变了世界吗？丝毫没有。如果你觉得自己能做得更好，那就去做。大声嚷嚷别人占了不公平的优势，不会改变你的人生——反而可能带来更多痛苦。

继续建设。继续改变世界。这才是产生影响力的最佳方式。永远把善良放在首位。

* 唯一的例外是：如果你是在揭露明显的欺诈，或指出某些糟糕透顶的东西，那就去做。显然有些公司的产品注定会沦为 vaporware（期货），如果你有证据，就大胆指出来。这不叫嫉妒，这是陈述事实，无论如何都算不上嘲讽。

If you can get the visual signal, auditory signal, balance, motor, in and out of the brain, that is an end in itself. That is the central object. Speaker 1 | 00:41 - 00:49

Speaker 2 | 00:56 - 01:17

Speaker 2 | 01:17 - 01:26

Speaker 1 | 01:26 - 01:27
Thanks for having me.

But I think if, like, the mission of lowercase s science is to use a differentiated understanding of the universe to improve the human condition, I mean, that's that's the mission of uppercase s science. That's what we do. We use, specifically an understanding of how to work with the brain to get big effect sizes that you don't get in medicine often. Our main product is a retinal prosthesis.

Speaker 1 | 01:58 - 02:16
You can think of it like a cochlear implant for the eye. Cochlear implants are some of the biggest impacts in all of medicine. I mean, you can if you've ever seen a video of a newborn turning on turning it on for the first time, it's striking. Speaker 2 | 02:16 - 02:21
And for people who are not familiar with that, it's a chip that's inserted with glasses.

Speaker 1 | 02:21 - 02:53
It's it's a tiny chip that's implanted under the retina in the back of the eye for patients that have gone blind due to loss of the light sensitive cells in the eye. So it is a chip that sits under the retina and then converts it to the patient, wears glasses that have a laser projector that projects an image onto the implant that then stimulates the retina to bypass the dead rods and cones and stimulate the retina directly to get a visual signal back into the brain.

Speaker 2 | 02:53 - 03:03

Speaker 1 | 04:03 - 04:25

podcasts.titleZh: 从恢复视力到重新构想大脑：对话 Max Hodak
podcasts.summaryZh: 本期 No Priors 邀请到 Max Hodak——脑机接口公司 Science 的创始人兼 CEO，也是 Neuralink 的联合创始人。两人聊了 Science 的创立使命、刚获欧洲监管批准的视网膜假体 Prima、脑机接口的行业图景，以及意识、身份与 AI 表征等话题。核心观点：1）大脑就是计算机：用设备而非药物干预大脑见效更快、更确定，人工耳蜗、深部脑刺激都是明证，而药物研发更像在自然界随机筛选，十年临床可能换来一张否定的牌；2）Prima 视网膜假体是里程碑：芯片植入视网膜下，患者佩戴激光投影眼镜，绕过坏死的感光细胞直接刺激视网膜，临床试验中盲人患者能读书、填数独，今年 7 月获欧洲 CE 认证即将开售；目前视野小如吸管、仅有黑白，团队正规划增加灰度乃至红绿色觉，下一代产品有望把适用人群从数十万扩展到数百万；3）BCI 的终极目标是基质独立：颅骨本就让我们成为“缸中之脑”，只要打通视觉、听觉、平衡与运动信号的进出，就能重画大脑边界、替换身体部件，消解人类生存的脆弱感，长远甚至能适应太空环境；4）AI 与大脑共享表征：“柏拉图表征假说”有实证支持，Science 已能对齐动物脑神经记录与 AI 模型内部表征，说明 AI 抓住了真实的数据流形，研究 AI 反而是当下研究神经科学的高效途径；5）身份的关键是连续性：人们能接受自我随时间大幅漂移，却难以接受没有现象学连续性的软件副本，而实现基质独立的重要前提是完成小鼠乃至人类的连接组图谱。
